title: H&M and Zara: Can fast fashion be eco-friendly?
speaker: DW Planet A
zh: 【DW Planet A】H&M 和 Zara：快時尚可以環保嗎？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.en: the amount of clothing per year as they did in the early 2000s.

cues.en: But companies say that’s about to change because we can now buy eco-friendly fast fashion!

cues.en: But can we believe them?

cues.text: in the world, and both have collections that claim to reduce the environmental impact of making clothes.
cues.en: in the world, and both have collections that claim to reduce the environmental impact of making clothes.
cues.zh: 在世界範圍內，兩家公司的產品系列都聲稱可以減少服裝製作對環境的影響。

cues.text: Not only that, but the two fashion giants say they are making their entire brands more sustainable.
cues.en: Not only that, but the two fashion giants say they are making their entire brands more sustainable.
cues.zh: 不僅如此，這兩家時尚巨頭還表示，他們正在使整個品牌變得更加永續。

cues.en: Let’s take a look at these promises, starting with the materials.

cues.en: which end up in the ocean and also in our food.
